summary: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Yonge Street, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting that Council not authorize the installation of traffic control signals on Yonge Street and Price Street/Marlborough Avenue as the technical justification for the installation of traffic control signals is not satisfied. Therefore, the installation of traffic control signals on Yonge Street and Price Street/Marlborough Avenue, is not recommended.
decided: City Council on July 16, 17 and 18, 2019, adopted the following: 1. City Council authorize the installation of traffic control signals on Yonge Street and Price Street/Marlborough Avenue.
